licence.note: Field names and one-line descriptions paraphrased from Splunk's published Add-on for CrowdStrike FDR docs, Splunk Security Content data-source pages, and Microsoft Learn's Mandatory Integrity Control page (for the integrity_level decode only); no page's text is reproduced beyond short attributed quotes. Examples are read from this workspace's own seeded samples, not copied from any vendor page.

record_kind.format: One fixed word (event_simpleName) or an Event_-prefixed word (ExternalApiType); which columns are filled depends on it.

ProcessRollup2.meaning: A process started; the sensor's one-per-process summary.

SyntheticProcessRollup2.meaning: A process the sensor learned about after it started (already running, or reconstructed).

ProcessHandleOpDetectInfo.meaning: A process opened a handle on another process; LSASS access lands here.

DmpFileWritten.meaning: A memory-dump file was written to disk.

Event_DetectionSummaryEvent.meaning: A Falcon detection: one row summarizing what the sensor caught and what policy did about it.

record_kind_raw.format: The record_kind value with Event_ stripped.

sha1.format: 40 lowercase hex characters in a real record.

examples.note: external; synthetic sample, 39 characters, one short of valid
external; synthetic sample, the MD5 of the literal string password

raw_process_id.format: A small decimal integer, the OS's own PID range.

target_process_id.format: A large decimal integer, the sensor's own process numbering.

parent_process_id.format: A large decimal integer, same numbering as target_process_id.

command_line.format: The full command string, quoting as the shell that ran it wrote it.

image_file_name.format: A device path (\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeN\\...) on sensor:ithr; a Windows path on external.

parent_base_file_name.format: Stripped down to its bare filename; nothing from the enclosing directory tree survives.

grand_parent_base_file_name.format: A bare file name, no path.

target_file_name.format: A device path on sensor:ithr, a drive-letter path on external (AssociatedFile).

event_time.format: Epoch milliseconds: a digit string on sensor:ithr, an unquoted integer on external.

Mac.note: Not seen in the seeded sample.

Lin.note: Not seen in the seeded sample.

process_start_time.format: Epoch seconds with a fractional part on sensor:ithr; a whole-second integer on external.

process_end_time.format: Same shape as process_start_time; empty when the process had not exited.

examples.note: external; empty on sensor:ithr's own ProcessRollup2 when the process had not exited

context_timestamp.format: Epoch seconds with a fractional part.

integrity_level.format: The decimal RID of a Windows S-1-16-<n> integrity SID.

desired_access.format: A decimal integer, a Windows access-rights bitmask.

window_title.format: Free text, the window's title bar.

tags.format: A comma-separated list of decimal integers.

event_name_version.format: A CamelCase name with a V<n> suffix.

detect_name.format: A short human title for the detection.

detect_description.format: One or two sentences of prose.

examples.value: A process associated with credential dumping wrote a minidump of LSASS memory.

severity.format: A decimal integer; see the severity_scale hazard before assuming its range.

technique.format: A MITRE ATT&CK technique name, with its id in parentheses.

pattern_disposition_value.format: A decimal integer bitmask; 0 seen when every named flag is false.

examples.value: Detected, standard detection, no action taken.

falcon_host_link.format: An https URL into the Falcon console.

ioc_type.format: One fixed word naming the shape of IOCValue.

ioc_value.format: Shape depends on ioc_type; a hash string in the sample.

host_groups.format: A JSON array written into one string field.

file_name.format: Just the file's own name, with no directory path attached.

device_id.format: A 32-hex-character lowercase id on the Hosts API device record.

external_ip.format: An IPv4 dotted address; the host's public IP as CrowdStrike's cloud saw it.

host_platform.format: One fixed word naming the OS platform family.

Mac.meaning: The only value observed in the dev tenant's 4 hosts, all macOS.

host_product_type.format: A short phrase naming the endpoint's role.

Workstation.meaning: The only value observed in the dev tenant's 4 hosts.

host_os_version.format: A free-text OS version string, vendor-specific in shape (for example a macOS build name or a Windows edition string).

sensor_agent_version.format: A dotted Falcon sensor version string.

last_login_user.format: A free-text account name; not copied here as an example because it is the trial tenant's real user (tenant_values_excluded).

last_login_user_sid.format: A Windows SID string (S-1-...); not copied here as an example (tenant_values_excluded).

normal.meaning: The only value observed in the dev tenant's 4 hosts; no containment or other state seen.

provision_status.format: One fixed word or short phrase.

Provisioned.meaning: The only value observed; the host has completed Falcon provisioning.

enabled.meaning: The only value observed; Real Time Response is turned on for the host.

reduced_functionality_mode.format: A lowercase yes/no word, despite the flag-shaped name.

no.meaning: The only value observed; the sensor is not running in reduced functionality mode.
The only value observed; the host was not last seen in OS safe mode.

normal.meaning: The only value observed; no containment applied.

host_criticality.format: One fixed word or short phrase.

unassigned.meaning: The only value observed; no criticality tag set on the host.

chassis_type_desc.format: A short phrase naming the hardware chassis type.

Other.meaning: The only value observed, on the dev tenant's Mac workstations.

Apple Inc..meaning: The only value observed, on the dev tenant's Mac workstations.

host_serial_number.format: A free-text hardware serial number; not copied here as an example (tenant_values_excluded).

policy_type.format: One fixed word naming a device_policies category.

sensor_update.meaning: The category this pack binds; seven others (prevention, firewall, device_control, global_config, host-retention, remote_response, logscale-collector) carry the same five subfields and are left unbound.

true.meaning: The policy has been applied to the host.

false.meaning: The policy is assigned but not yet applied.

audit_event_type.format: One CamelCase word naming the audit envelope's own event category.

APIActivityAuditEvent.meaning: An audit record for a call made through CrowdStrike's OAuth2 API.

AuthActivityAuditEvent.meaning: An audit record for an authentication action (for example a login or a stream start/stop).

AuditLogV3Event.meaning: A general platform audit-log record; the sample's Category/Action for this type overlap with the API and auth ones.

audit_category.format: A short phrase naming the producing service.

Crowdstrike API Client.meaning: The record concerns an OAuth2 API client's own lifecycle (for example UpdateAPIClient).

Crowdstrike Streaming API.meaning: The record concerns a Streaming API session (start or stop).

api_request.meaning: The record is a per-request API audit log entry.

audit_action.format: One word or short phrase naming the audited action.

UpdateAPIClient.meaning: An API client's configuration was changed.

logged.meaning: A per-request audit line for an API call.

streamStarted.meaning: A Streaming API session was opened.

streamStopped.meaning: A Streaming API session was closed.

actor_type_code.format: A small integer; observed values are 1, 2 and 3, meaning undocumented in any accessible source (undocumented_codes).

actor_id.format: An opaque id string; not copied here as an example (tenant_values_excluded).

api_client_id.format: A 32-hex-character OAuth2 client id; not copied here as an example (tenant_values_excluded).

audit_status_code.format: An HTTP status code, as a number.

404.meaning: The requested resource was not found.

true.meaning: The only value observed in the sample; every one of the 467 records succeeded.

target_type_code.format: An integer code; only 0 observed, meaning undocumented in any accessible source (undocumented_codes).

United States.meaning: The only value observed; reflects this one trial tenant's own location, not a fixed enumeration.

stream_offset.format: A non-negative integer, increasing within one stream session.
